newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN LAND WILKINS AS PART OF DOUBLE SWOOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN LAND WILKINS AS PART OF DOUBLE SWOOP.

text.p: Scottish premier league club Hibernian completed a double signing on Friday, recruiting former England star Ray Wilkins and German under-21 midfielder Thorsten Schmugge.
Wilkins, who will mark his 40th birthday by playing against Raith on Saturday, has signed a month's deal with a view to a longer contract. Schmugge has also signed initially for a trial period.
Wilkins quit nine days ago as player-manager of Queen's Park Rangers, who were relegated from the English premier division last season.
Hibernian manager Alex Miller said: "Ray is a very intelligent player from the midfield area and will be a tremendous asset."

Wilkins is relishing the prospect of returning to the Scottish premier division after two-and-a-half years with Glasgow Rangers earlier in his career. He is eligible to face the Scottish champions in the League Cup at Ibrox on Wednesday.

"We have to get Raith out of the way first but I'm looking forward to going back to Ibrox," he said. "I don't know what kind of reception I'll get from the fans but I only have pleasant memories of my time there."
